text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the crack of dawn following a day off,
Admire
Vega starts training by herself.
However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can't concentrate at all. Why am I so...
so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Stupid... I mean... staying up all night
just to buy a
pair of slippers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega looks to be
sleep-deprived.
